scopeLabel: Source-scoped preparations and associated SAXS, microscopy and optical evidence from the complete 10-page main article and 32-page SI. CdSe, PbS and CdS routes, stocks, workup, separate laboratory benchmark, double-injection variants, single-injection controls and partial calibration preparations are distinct. Theoretical curves and reference structures are explicitly separated from measured specimens. No exact unreported batch, graph coordinate or atomic structure is reconstructed; no complete-paper Reader is claimed.

availability.morphology_illustration: Source images and reported size/shape evidence are retained. Finite particle geometry is not reconstructed. The two explicitly gated CdSe bulk cells are independent references, not sample structures.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
